anf_compare.notes: Translated from the PG 77 Greek. No published English version was used for wording.

choices.why: Plain English for a softened 'perhaps, it may be'.

choices.english: then slip in to obtain ordination
choices.why: To run in under, creep in for ordinations; πάλιν rendered once, as 'then'.

choices.english: even stay away from the assemblies
choices.why: παραιτέομαι: to decline, beg off; natural English for refusing to attend.
The eucharistic offering, without adding a noun the Greek lacks.

pass_a_gloss: [continuing from the previous section: ...hastily carry along some of the most God loving] bishops (episkopos), and with no one perhaps (tacha pou) reporting (apangellō) the things concerning them, they are ordained (cheirotoneō) clerics (klērikos), or at any rate (goun) presbyters (presbyteros). (b) Concerning those going out (exerchomai) from monasteries and being ordained. And others, some being expelled (ekballō) as disorderly (ataktos) from the very monasteries, again run in under (hypotrechō) the ordinations (cheirotonia), and having become clerics they enter even into the very monasteries from which they have been expelled, and they wish to offer (prospherō) and to fulfil (plēroō) whatever is custom (ethos) for clerics; and to do these things, so that (hōs) some of those who know them decline (paraiteomai) even the assemblies (synaxis) and do not bear (anechomai) to commune (koinōneō) while those men officiate (leitourgeō).
pass_b_english: …bishops; and since perhaps no one reports their circumstances, they are ordained clerics, or even presbyters.
2. On those who leave monasteries and are ordained

Others, expelled as disorderly from the monasteries themselves, then slip in to obtain ordination; and once they have become clerics, they enter even the very monasteries from which they were expelled, and wish to make the offering and to perform all that clerics are accustomed to do. And they do this, so that some who know them even stay away from the assemblies and cannot bear to share in communion while those men are officiating.
source_text:
ἐπισκόπων, καὶ οὐδενὸς τάχα που τὰ κατ' αὐτοὺς ἀπαγγέλλοντος, χειροτονοῦνται
κληρικοί, ἢ γοῦν πρεσβύτεροι.
(β) Περὶ τῶν ἐκ μοναστηρίων ἐξερχομένων καὶ χειροτονουμένων. Ἕτεροι δέ
τινες ἐξ αὐτῶν τῶν μοναστηρίων ὡς ἄτακτοι ἐκβαλλόμενοι, πάλιν ὑποτρέχουσι τὰς
χειροτονίας, καὶ γενόμενοι κληρικοὶ εἰσέρχονται καὶ ἐν αὐτοῖς τοῖς μοναστηρίοις,
ὅθεν ἐκβέβληνται, καὶ βούλονται προσφέρειν καὶ ὅσα κληρικοῖς ἔθος πληροῦν· καὶ
ταῦτα δρᾶν, ὡς καί τινας τῶν εἰδότων αὐτοὺς παραιτεῖ 283 σθαι καὶ τὰς συνάξεις καὶ
μὴ ἀνέχεσθαι κοινωνεῖν λειτουργούντων ἐκείνων.
reviewer: claude (Wave A review, clause by clause against the Greek)
review_notes: Replaces a scaffold row ('Rem early: …'); the section had no real English before Wave A.
Checked clause by clause against the Greek: 'Ἕτεροι δέ τινες ἐξ αὐτῶν τῶν μοναστηρίων ὡς ἄτακτοι ἐκβαλλόμενοι' = 'Others, expelled as disorderly from the monasteries themselves'.
Reviewer rv0 fixes applied before merge: 'perhaps' for τάχα που; πάλιν rendered once ('then'); 'go on doing' cut, since δρᾶν carries no sense of continuing; 'stay away from' for παραιτεῖσθαι.
The section opens mid-sentence; the opening ellipsis marks the join with the previous section. Page marker 283 (which splits παραιτεῖσθαι) is not rendered.
No Scripture quoted or alluded to in this section.
